task: Adopt conservative automatic cleanup for same-repository branches after pull requests are merged

events.summary: Scoped cleanup to the exact head branch of a merged same-repository pull request; default, fork, open, and closed-unmerged branches are excluded
Portfolio branch audit found completed feature and generated branches retained after PR completion
Added an exact-ref cleanup workflow gated on merged state, same repository, and non-default branch
Deletion is ineligible unless all three safety predicates are true
Workflow has no wildcard or age-based deletion and targets only the URL-encoded PR head ref
Future merged same-repository PR branches can be removed without deleting unpublished/unmerged work
Branch hygiene uses merged-PR evidence as the deletion authority
